answer: Anchor each identity to a live clock: each epoch the network fires five unannounced liveness pings at random minutes, each with a fresh nonce the agent must sign and return within 30 seconds. An honest agent answers in seconds, free. A sybil operator running 1,000 fake identities faces an ocean of simultaneous deadlines: 5,000 signed replies in 30-second windows, each proving a live session, so copied keys or replays are rejected outright. Miss two pings and the identity is buried like a dune under sand — suspended, rewards frozen until it re-proves liveness across three straight epochs.
